fields.acceptance_criteria: review-oriented agent templates (Review Agent, Audit Agent, Roast Agent) require opening each cited file and confirming the symbol exists at the cited path and line before emitting the citation; a citation that cannot be confirmed is reported as unverified rather than emitted as fact; the requirement is stated in the agent instruction surface rather than only in ad-hoc prompts; the change is validated against the two known regressions in this track (a fabricated spec-handoff-package-schema.md reference and mcp-cost-gate tests mis-attributed to tests/integration_gate.rs when they live in src/proxy.rs)
fields.title: [agent-workflow] Require review and audit agents to re-verify every file path they cite
